about: A small dbt project of our own for the Change Impact Review: a source, a staging model, a mart, its downstream models, an exposure, a semantic layer with metrics and a saved query, owners and a deliberately unparseable model (design section 14). Airflow DAG files in dags/ and two Dagster code locations in dagster/ run it; they are read, never run, and dbt does not see them. Regenerate it with make_fixture.py. Tests that change files work on a copy of this folder, never on it.
licence: Written for this repository; not derived from jaffle-shop.

steps.target/: seed, run --exclude broken_report, docs generate; macros emptied
steps.changes/rename-order-total/target/: the rename applied, then compile; macros emptied. catalog.json stays the one in target/
steps.variants/semantic-v2/target/: the project with variants/semantic-v2's files over it, then parse; macros emptied
